name: Meta Sturgeon data centre
summary: Meta's first data centre in Canada, a 1 GW campus optimized for its AI workloads in Sturgeon County, Alberta, in the Edmonton region, with more than CA$13 billion of planned investment. Meta announced the groundbreaking in July 2026. Meta says it is fully funding new generation and grid infrastructure in Alberta and names Greenlight Limited Partnership, AltaLink, Capital Power and the Alberta Electric System Operator as energy-planning partners. Frost Collective, a joint venture of Clark Builders and PCL Construction, is the general contractor. The project website's page description cites 1.6 GW, which differs from Meta's 1 GW figure.

location.note: County point from OpenStreetMap Nominatim; Meta names Sturgeon County but no specific site, and the project website places it in the Edmonton region.

notes: Meta's fact sheet PDF (s3) shows no publication date; its embedded file creation date is in early September 2026. The project website (s4) is undated; its 1.6 GW figure carries the date it was read (2026-10-09).
